title: Configure composite dimensions in unified current-page grouping
description: Customer groups the same report by customer and month in chosen order using one generic engine. Current execution rejects more than one saved grouping: support at most two distinct catalogued base dimensions, initially customer/month in either order, without source joins or new business reports. Dimension metadata identifies authorized required fields, stable typed key and label and calendar-month semantics; no grouping on related/calculated/unauthorized fields yet. New grouping list and legacy single GroupBy request/defaults remain compatible; conflicting overrides rejected clearly. Provider fetches authorized dependencies using ungrouped source page, common engine groups only those current-page facts and projects only selected fields. Typed tuple keys avoid string-concatenation collision and deterministic customer/month order; missing dimensions form explicit unknown bucket. Selected metrics from ERP-267 compute per tuple and currency partition, preserve null/missing counts and no mixed currencies/units. Label coverage as current-page, not all matching facts; do not change page total or silently repage grouped results. No header duplication or fact multiplication. Persist JSON and immutable shared revisions; UI ordered dimension selection, bounded state and late-response protection. Universal exports render all composite group dimensions and selected metrics in their saved order; old subtotal contract remains backward compatible. Existing max32 columns, max200 page rows, 1MiB preview/10MiB file/deadline budgets remain authoritative. Stage 1 unified platform only; existing sales-order/receivable adapters are engine fixtures, not migration or new bespoke reports. Preserve old report entries until every fixed/dynamic report passes Stage 2 parity. No Agent or cross-business flow work. Server-authenticated identity and fresh existing menu/field/row/data scope remain authoritative, saved definitions/grants never grant ERP permissions. No arbitrary SQL, scripts, joins, tables, mixed currency/unit totals or one-to-many header duplication. No migrations, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modifications, production SQL/database execution, schema/view/procedure changes, secrets/.env/config changes, deployment or irreversible operations. Use existing HTTP and entity audit conventions. Safe build/test and relevant offline integration tests required; missing actual DB/browser/font environment must be explicitly blocked, never claim the phase complete from build. Preserve unrelated source/work.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog and persisted definitions validate two ordered base dimensions and legacy single-group compatibility, rejecting duplicate/unknown/unauthorized or conflicting dimensions.
Generic grouping and selected metrics use typed composite keys, authorized hidden dependencies, stable order and unknown/currency partitions over current page without changing source facts.
Workspace and universal Excel/PDF agree on saved dimension order, summaries and current-page coverage; offline key-collision/null/scope/compatibility tests pass safe build/test.
